{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the total number of rows
print(f"Total number of rows in dataset: {len(penguins)}")

# Check the number of missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of missing values in 'body_mass_g': {missing_body_mass}")

# Drop rows where body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Print the mean
print(f"Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}")"}
